name: Boulder Gap
description: A miniature world of weathered granite at the scale of a hand: two boulders lean together around a saddle packed with cushion moss, lichen crusts on every face under cool overcast light. Raw inland geology, intimate and tactile.
subject: either
prompt: A miniature world of weathered granite at the scale of a hand: two deliberately unmatched boulders lean together, their faces rising like small cliffs around a natural saddle packed with deep green cushion moss. Real mineral banding and quartz veins run through the stone, with ochre and pale-sage lichen crusts and dark water stains where runoff tracks down the faces. Cool overcast daylight with a soft bias from one side separates the stone faces by tone rather than hard shadow, and a faint warm bounce comes off the lichen. Raw inland geology, intimate and tactile, photographed on location.
